question.prompt: \(OA\) is a radius of circle \(O\). Line \(l\) passes through point \(A\), and \(l\perp OA\). How many points do \(l\) and circle \(O\) have in common?

solutions.explanation: Line \(l\) passes through the endpoint \(A\) of a radius on the circle and is perpendicular to the radius, so it is tangent to circle \(O\). A tangent and a circle have only 1 point in common.
solutions.title: Recognize a tangent
